disclaimer: Simplified estimate combining 18% personal income tax + 5% military levy into a single 23% effective rate on gross income. USC (unified social contribution) is employer-paid in most cases and excluded.

regimes.label: Income Tax + Military Levy (23% combined)
regimes.notes: Ukraine applies 18% PIT plus 5% military levy, both on gross income, equivalent to a combined 23% flat rate.
